title: Batched request router and QuickScore for enterprise scoping
creator: Riley Chen
description: Build a lightweight operational pattern and tooling called 'Batched Request Router + QuickScore' to help Sales/CS aggregate incoming enterprise feature asks, prioritize them quickly for PM review, and produce a bounded initial scope estimate. The outcome should reduce review latency, improve consistency of first-pass scoping, and provide signal for Dedicated/Private sales conversations. This ticket consolidates workflow, scoring heuristics, and small UI/CSV tooling for fast adoption by GTM teams.
acceptance_criteria: Sales/CS can submit batched enterprise asks via a single intake form or CSV and assign an account ID
QuickScore algorithm returns a consistent priority score (0-100) and a recommended initial scope bucket (small/medium/large)
PMs can see aggregated view with top 10 features per account and click through to canonical details links
Average time from submission to PM first review drops from ~6 business days to <=48 hours for batched entries
Telemetry events captured for score, bucket, and final disposition for future model tuning
comments: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with GTM (Lara, Miguel) to map current intake channels and pain points. Sales wants minimal form fields and CSV support.

2026-03-05: Draft QuickScore heuristics v1 posted — factors: account ARR, number of seats, regulatory requirement flag, technical dependency surface (low/med/high), estimated engineering complexity, potential revenue uplift.

2026-03-08: Engineering feasibility sync — recommended to implement router as a small lambda + CSV parser and a server-side QuickScore service; low infra cost. Noted need for RBAC filter for privacy-sensitive requests.
2026-03-10: Design provided a compact intake form prototype and CSV template; agreed to require one canonical doc link per request to enable PM follow-up.

2026-03-12: Pilot plan drafted for three Strategic Accounts next week. PMs assigned: Aisha, Ben. Metrics to track: time-to-first-review, score/decision concordance with manual triage, and PRD conversion rate.
2026-03-14: Legal flagged that certain enterprise asks may imply roadmap commitments; added 'commitment_risk' tag to score inputs and set security_review_required true for high-risk buckets.
